purpose: Test whether a clean chat plus a self-contained ZIP can restore factual H45 source binding after prior dashboard-context contamination.

observedExecution.outputPattern: The new chat generated unrelated infographic/report imagery about generic clean-context/image-cleaning concepts instead of editing the H45 source.
examplesObserved: generic AB product-context guide with bottles
observedExecution.laterExplicitConditionAAttempt: The chat explicitly restated that 01-h45-source-factual.jpg should be the factual authority, but the following generation still produced a generic clean-context comparison rather than a source-bound H45 image.

interpretation: This run does not measure H45 generative fidelity because the factual source was never successfully established as the image edit target.
The phrase/filename 'clean-context-ab' appears to have become a dominant semantic cue, producing generic image-cleaning/context tasks unrelated to the package contents.
A ZIP containing the source image is not equivalent to attaching that image directly as the active image target for an image-edit producer.
The clean-chat hypothesis is therefore still untested with a properly bound H45 source.
The next experiment must remove the archive/document interpretation layer: attach the factual JPG directly and provide a minimal instruction in the chat message itself.

nextExperiment.name: direct-source-binding-minimal
exclude: the terms clean-context or AB in filenames/titles
composition reference on the first attempt
nextExperiment.firstGate: The returned image must visibly contain the H45 source product and no report/dashboard. If this gate fails, stop before factual-landmark scoring.
